_comment: nhlua.c nhl_loadlua() on non-Lua playground files. #wizloadlua './license' (a dot in the name, so no '.lua' is appended) makes luaL_loadbuffer() fail with "syntax error near 'GENERAL'" on line 1; C prints impossible("luaL_loadbuffer: Error loading %s: %s"). The second load names options through twenty './' parts, so the chunk name '(...)' is longer than the 45 bytes Lua's luaO_chunkid() keeps and is cut with '...', and the error is on line 2.
